actual_scope: Prove negative association of the three binary orthogonal-kernel full-guard indicators under a uniformly sampled complete GL_m(F_2) header, for every m >= 3; close PR4777 open question 1.
scope_change_reason: The donor explicitly selected this mathematical question. The contribution is a written dimension-uniform inequality and an increasing-function reduction, with exact independent corroboration, rather than a proof-assistant formalization of a selected caller.

stop_rule: Stop after proving or refuting the union-versus-singleton inequality for every m >= 3, justifying the complete negative-association reduction, and independently checking finite header distributions and cited inputs. Do not extend to odd fields or four requests in this contribution.
evidence: README Sections 2-4 give an analytic union gap Delta > p^2*((7/9)^(m-1)-p) > 0 and complete monotone-function reduction, using credited predecessor laws and conjunction theorem. The stdlib verifier independently enumerates 20,328 complete GL3/GL4 headers, 71 Gram-walk comparisons, all 64 triple characters, 3,048 strict covariance comparisons over 254 dimensions, the 40 finite cases of the cited conjunction proof and its tail constants, and nine rejecting controls. These finite checks corroborate, rather than extrapolate, the universal argument.
